name: Fujiwara no Michinaga
source:
Hobby: Collecting Others' Weaknesses

He takes part in politics of the Flower Palace as a noble. He is good at archery and things related to literature, especially Waka. His accent is also one of his features.

[From [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
